records.text: Turning Point USA said it could not host Erika Kirk at Pinnacle High School because of serious death threats received over the previous few days.
records.speaker: Turning Point USA

appearances.snippet: Hey, everyone. I wanted to share some important news about the event with Erika Kirk. Unfortunately, we are unable to host her at Pinnacle High School after school due to serious death threats that she has received over the past few days.

verification.notes: The primary episode transcript records Owens reading a Turning Point USA event email that says the organization could not host Kirk at Pinnacle High School because of serious threats received over the preceding days. Public reporting separately confirms TPUSA had recently cited serious threats against Kirk, though the school-specific email is not independently posted.

sources.relevance: Confirms TPUSA publicly said Kirk had recently received serious threats, while noting officials found no credible UGA threat.

records.text: Candace Owens said the Pinnacle High School event was canceled because of a boycott led by parents, teachers, and students, not because of death threats.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: No, she had not canceled because of death threats. She canceled because there was a boycott, which was led by the By the parents and the teachers and the students who do not want Erika Kirk at their school.

verification.notes: Reporting confirms strong parent and student backlash and that the appearance was moved off campus, not simply canceled. It does not establish a coordinated boycott by parents, teachers, and students as the sole cause, and safety concerns were also publicly cited; the categorical claim that threats played no role is unsupported.

sources.relevance: Arizona Republic syndication confirms parent backlash and safety concerns.

sources.title: High School Moves Erika Kirk Event Off Campus After Students Revolt
sources.relevance: Confirms the school moved the event off campus after backlash rather than canceling it outright.

records.text: Candace Owens cited Newsweek, The Daily Beast, and The Arizona Republic reports describing parent and student backlash to Erika Kirk's high-school appearance.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Here's a Newsweek headline. They wrote Erika Kirk's high school talk sparks furious backlash from parents. ... Here's a Daily Beast. High school moves Erika Kirk event off campus after students revolt. ... Here is the local Arizona Republic, a high school group invited Erika Kirk to campus. Parents are not happy.

verification.notes: The episode accurately names and quotes the Newsweek, Daily Beast, and Arizona Republic coverage. Live results confirm the Daily Beast and Arizona Republic stories and their parent/student backlash framing; the episode transcript preserves the Newsweek headline citation.
